faq.metaTitle: Importing Cars from China to Ghana: FAQ
faq.metaDescription: Answers about importing and shipping a car from China to Ghana: how it works, cost, shipping, customs clearing at Tema Port and tracking.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Common questions about sourcing, shipping, tracking and importing a vehicle from China to Ghana.

howItWorks.a: You tell us what you're looking for — vehicle type, budget and any must-have specifications. We identify matching options from verified suppliers in China, the vehicle is inspected and verified before purchase, and we then arrange shipping and customs clearing to Ghana.

shippingTime.a: It depends on the specific vehicle, the shipping method (RoRo or container) and the route, so we don't quote a single fixed timeline. Once a vehicle is selected, we give you an estimate specific to your request.
shippingTime.link: Shipping cars from China to Ghana, explained

price.q: Can I get a price before I commit to anything?
price.a: Pricing depends on the vehicle's specification, shipping and current exchange rates, so we don't list fixed prices on the site. Reach out via Source My Vehicle, WhatsApp or email and we'll follow up with a full quote for your specific request.

tracking.q: Can I track my order after I submit a request?
tracking.a: Yes. Every fleet or sourcing request gets a tracking reference, shown on screen when you submit and emailed to you if you provide an address. Enter it on the Track page to see its current status.

ev.q: Do you source electric and hybrid vehicles?
ev.a: Yes. We have used electric, hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles available now, with range and battery details on each listing where available.

documents.q: What documents do I need to import a vehicle?
documents.a: Requirements depend on your specific vehicle and situation. We handle documentation and customs clearing on your behalf as part of the import process.
documents.link: Clearing a vehicle through Ghanaian customs

inspection.q: Is every vehicle inspected before it ships?
inspection.a: Yes. Vehicles go through inspection and verification before any purchase is finalized, confirming the vehicle's actual condition and specifications match what was represented.

fleet.q: Do you source vehicles for businesses and fleets, not just individuals?
fleet.a: Yes. We work with ride-hailing operators, logistics businesses, dealers, corporate organisations and institutions.

condition.q: Are the vehicles new or used?
condition.a: The vehicles listed now are used, from our partner in China, and each one is inspected before purchase. If you want a new vehicle, tell us in a sourcing request and we will find options for you. On the Vehicles page you can filter by brand, body type, fuel and year.

contact.q: How do I get in touch with a sourcing specialist?
contact.a: Through the Source My Vehicle form, WhatsApp, or by email at {email}.

shipping.metaTitle: Shipping Cars from China to Ghana (Tema Port)
shipping.metaDescription: How to ship a car from China to Ghana: sourcing, inspection, RoRo or container shipping to Tema Port, customs clearing and delivery. Get a full quote.
shipping.title: Shipping cars from China to Ghana
shipping.answer: China2Ghana Motors ships cars from China to Ghana for you. We find the vehicle you want from verified suppliers in China, inspect it before purchase, ship it by RoRo or container to Tema Port, clear it through Ghanaian customs and deliver it to you. You get one full quote and a tracking reference for the whole journey.
shipping.stepsTitle: How shipping a car from China to Ghana works

steps.title: Tell us what you need
steps.body: Share the vehicle, budget and must-have specifications, or choose a vehicle we already have in China.

steps.title: Choose from matching options
steps.body: We send options from verified suppliers with a full quote covering the vehicle, inspection, shipping and clearing.

steps.title: Inspection before purchase
steps.body: The vehicle is inspected in China to confirm its condition and specifications match what was described, before you pay.

steps.title: Purchase and export
steps.body: Once you approve, we buy the vehicle and prepare it and its export documents for shipping.

steps.title: Shipping to Tema Port
steps.body: The vehicle is shipped from China to Tema Port, Ghana, by RoRo or in a container. You can follow each stage with your tracking reference.

steps.title: Clearing and delivery
steps.body: We handle customs clearing at Tema Port and arrange delivery of your vehicle.

shipping.roroBody: The vehicle is driven onto a specialised car-carrier ship and driven off at Tema Port. It is the most common and usually the most economical way to ship a standard car.
shipping.containerBody: The vehicle is loaded into a shipping container, on its own or with other cargo. It gives more protection on the voyage and suits higher-value vehicles.
shipping.costTitle: What affects the cost of shipping a car from China to Ghana
shipping.costIntro: There is no single price, because the total depends on:
costFactors: The vehicle itself: make, model, year and condition
The shipping method: RoRo or container
Inspection and export preparation in China
Import duties, taxes and fees charged by Ghanaian customs, which depend on the vehicle's value, age and type
Exchange rates at the time of purchase
shipping.costNote: Every request gets a full written quote before you commit, so you know the total cost of your car in Ghana.
shipping.clearingBody: When the vehicle arrives at Tema Port it must be cleared through Ghanaian customs before it is released. We prepare and submit the documents, keep you informed of duties and fees as they are confirmed, and arrange delivery once the vehicle is released.
shipping.faqTitle: Shipping a car from China to Ghana: questions

howTo.q: How do I ship a car from China to Ghana?
howTo.a: Tell us the vehicle you want or pick one from our stock in China. We inspect it, buy it once you approve, ship it to Tema Port by RoRo or container, clear it through customs and deliver it to you. You deal with one company and one quote from start to finish.

time.q: How long does it take to ship a car from China to Ghana?
time.a: It depends on the vehicle, the shipping method and the sailing schedule, so we don't promise one fixed timeline. Once your vehicle is selected we give you an estimate for your shipment, and you can follow every stage with your tracking reference.

cost.q: How much does it cost to ship a car from China to Ghana?
cost.a: The cost depends on the vehicle, RoRo or container shipping, inspection, Ghanaian import duties and exchange rates. Send a request and we reply with a full quote covering the vehicle, shipping and clearing.

port.q: Which port in Ghana do cars from China arrive at?
port.a: We ship vehicles from China to Tema Port, Ghana, where they are cleared through customs before delivery.

method.q: Is RoRo or container shipping better for a car?
method.a: RoRo is usually the most economical choice for a standard car. A container gives more protection and suits higher-value vehicles. We recommend the method that fits your vehicle and budget.

ev.q: Can I import an electric or hybrid car from China to Ghana?
ev.a: Yes. We have used electric, hybrid and plug-in hybrid vehicles available in China, and they go through the same inspection, shipping and clearing as any other vehicle.

clearing.q: Do you handle customs clearing in Ghana?
clearing.a: Yes. We prepare the documents and handle customs clearing at Tema Port, and tell you about duties and fees as they are confirmed.

tracking.q: Can I track my car while it is being shipped?
tracking.a: Yes. Every request gets a tracking reference. Enter it on our Track page to see which stage your vehicle is at, from sourcing to delivery.
